## Strategy Succession — prospective freeze before confirmation

This continues additive scope notice6390556520. Preferred Edition02 and existing native/adapter/publication owner lanes remain intact. No new confirmatory outcome has been generated or examined.

**Frozen identities**
- Scientific execution source: `7e5a1dd2dcf7eb00ec055f1858d5dd722cc950f15f33314bb94c456c753845a7`.
- Complete52-file scientific/checker/browser/protocol freeze: `6d0308707f3909fd18d086a950d237835dafd9ab6cfa9a559846715f46613827`.
- Protocol: `177f3332d5ed3352fb2118f093621a018eb5949c9db248aa39e34969a800e1e8`.
- Separate Python checker: `1733a8d9910e4a2a462cc5dd1c0acd78fd7af629bb4f1ab02facf7b53f8de76c`.
- Unexecuted package: `f1b3e03fc5ae9a8798c8781bd94efc13181ee626385333819c3b94348795b0ce` (19,071,001 bytes,635 payload files), saved durably and retrieved with an exact hash match at23:33:19UTC before launch.

The targeted implementation review closes the documented paired-budget, recovery-freshness, checkpoint/checker reservation and incumbent-maintenance findings. Earlier failures and tests keep their original source identities. The final frozen offline browser passes its scoped useful-plan, recovery, authority and renderer checks; this is source execution, not a public deployment or installed runtime claim.

**Registered experiment.**12 independent streams×72 fresh offered missions, including the first mission; three balanced ordinary/tight/repair windows. Primary cumulative cap1,000,000 declared units; descriptive250,000/2,000,000 sensitivities. Eight arms include strong portfolio, saved workflow, equally enabled conventional learner, selective flywheel and discovery/admission/retention/succession ablations. Fixed training-only successive halving uses6 training tasks per stage; one exact nominee then receives4 fresh paired qualification tasks. Each pair has equal50,000 total-pipeline allocations, with actual solver allowance disclosed. Stage cap500,000. Main mission inputs are generated once and semantically/seed checked for exposure overlap before any arm executes.

Primary contrast is paired flywheel minus saved-workflow qualified coverage at1M, with10,000 stream-level percentile-bootstrap resamples, seed20261024. Stops/failures stay in the offered denominator; no post-launch exclusions or tuning. A separate12-stream, four-mission constructive diagnostic compares inherited, removed, rebuilt and equivalent ancestry under5M/1.5M caps. Correctness-only retention in that diagnostic is never relabelled economic promotion. The fixed native HiGHS subset is36 tasks in deadline and makespan modes with2-second solve limits; native wall/CPU and opaque work stay separate from interpreted work units. Authorship/model/human monetary costs remain unknown.

The actual recovered Strategy Lab has now also passed fresh original frozen-policy replay on CPython3.13.5:6 attempts/27,648 cases, exact non-timing equality, no source edit or runtime-guard bypass. This supplements the separate193,536-artifact audit; it is not a fresh acquisition-search experiment or independent institutional replication. Benchmark promotion, practical adoption and recovery of the full research investment remain different claims.

Next: one bounded confirmation launch on the unchanged released Alpha1.42.0 createWorkbench closure atc352bad0, followed by independent artifact/statistical audit and additive exact-artifact handoff. No new credentials, live financial actions, held Harness/Fleet retries, source self-modification or parallel publisher. No self-acceleration, commercial growth or public deployment is presumed.
